propositions: CLI facade reconstructs command identity through 19 overlapping frozensets, regex-based reference generation, and hand-maintained help resources causing parser/help drift and inconsistency
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack canonical help; `rebar help <command>` reports them unknown while handler-owned `--help` is inconsistent and can execute work

Proposed lazy route registry will unify command identity, spelling/visibility, parser-factory references, and generated package-help using a single side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory shared by runtime and build-time generation
All visible commands must appear once in grouped overview with byte-current generated package data returned before operation/config/mount boundaries
Semantic capability registry will map capabilities to packaging extras and missing postures without eager optional imports or affecting domain component result shapes
